title: Exact-Form Regret for Gradient Descent, Mirror Descent and Follow-the-Regularized-Leader
abstract: arXiv:2609.09466v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Online gradient descent is usually studied through external regret, where the learner competes with fixed alternatives. Recent work shows that first-order methods control richer action-dependent deviations. We ask for a geometric characterization of the deviations with respect to which online gradient descent, mirror descent, and follow-the-regularized-leader (FTRL) achieve no regret. We identify exactness as the common principle. Exactness means that the relevant displacement field is generated by a scalar potential, or equivalently that the associated one-form is exact in the geometry used by the algorithm. This geometry depends on the algorithm. For gradient descent it is Euclidean geometry, for mirror descent it is the geometry induced by the regularizer, and for FTRL it is the cumulative dual state. translated_title: 梯度下降、镜像下降与正则化领先跟随算法的精确形式遗憾
translated_abstract: 在线梯度下降通常通过外部遗憾来研究，其中学习者与固定的替代策略竞争。最近的研究表明，一阶方法能够控制更丰富的依赖于动作的偏差。本文旨在对在线梯度下降、镜像下降和正则化领先跟随（FTRL）实现无遗憾的偏差给出几何刻画。我们将“精确性”确定为共同原理。精确性意味着相关的位移场由一个标量势生成，或者等价地，相关的一形式在算法所使用的几何中是恰当的。这种几何依赖于具体算法：对于梯度下降是欧几里得几何，对于镜像下降是由正则化子诱导的几何，对于FTRL则是累积对偶状态。在温和的正则性条件下，精确性带来次线性遗憾，而非零环量则构成了互补的阻碍。
tldr: 本文提出“精确性”（即位移场由标量势生成、一形式恰当）作为统一几何原理，刻画了梯度下降、镜像下降和FTRL实现次线性遗憾的条件，并指出非零环量是产生遗憾的互补阻碍。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "exactness" — the displacement field being generated by a scalar potential with an exact one-form — as a unifying geometric principle characterizing when gradient descent, mirror descent, and FTRL achieve sublinear regret, with nonzero circulation providing the complementary obstruction.
